Select: chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie (efo_id prefixed with 'EFO:'), indication_label (mesh_heading), max_phase_for_ind. Source: molecule_dictionary, compound_structures, drug_indication. Join: molecule_dictionary.molregno = drug_indication.molregno, molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno. Filter: max_phase_for_ind = 4 AND mesh_heading = 'chronic kidney disease'. Sort: chembl_id ASC, pref_name ASC, canonical_smiles ASC, indication_curie ASC, indication_label ASC, max_phase_for_ind ASC.
